prs.title: fix: propagate SSE stream errors to waiting requests
prs.author: heyhayes
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs have unknown CI status. On the tiebreaker of "smallest focused diff," #2374 (2 files) would normally edge out #2122 (3 files). However, the approaches differ in a concrete way that is relevant to issue #1401: #2374 converts silent swallowing into logging — an observability improvement — but the exception still does not reach the waiting caller. #2122 propagates the SSE stream error to waiting requests, meaning callers receive the error instead of hanging or seeing no response. Additionally, #2122 is older (lower PR number), giving it more time under maintainer review, and its extra file may represent test coverage. On balance, the more complete error-propagation approach outweighs the two-vs-three file difference.
